---
title: cookies
---

`cookies` is an async function: `const cookieStore = await cookies()`.

Since Next.js 16, synchronous access (`cookies().get(...)`) is no longer
supported; await it first.

```ts
cookies(): Promise<ReadonlyRequestCookies>;
```

`cookieStore.getAll()` returns every cookie; `cookieStore.set(name, value, options)`
works in Server Actions and Route Handlers and throws in Server Components.
